QuestInfo.name: Endurance Training
QuestInfo.0: Time for the third training course from #b#p2151010##k. Talk to #b#p2151010##k at the #m310010010# in the Resistance Headquarters to begin.
QuestInfo.1: The next course is meant to build endurance. Go inside the #b#m310010300##k and eliminate #r#o9300411#s#k within. Since #o9300411# has very high HP, eliminating it will take time and patience.
QuestInfo.2: You finish #p2151010#'s third course without breaking a sweat. All this basic training is making you eager to build your strength back up.

0.0: Ready for the third course? Truly great Warriors need the endurance to withstand constant attacks. Otherwise you'll tire too quickly, and start getting sloppy. You don't wanna be sloppy, do you?
0.1: Now, are you ready to start the next course?

yes.0: Good. It's good to see you recover your strength.
yes.1: When you enter #b#m310010300##k, you'll find some #r#o9300411#s#k. Between their strength and high HP, you'll have to wear them down. They're not too dangerous, but don't take them lightly. Stick with it, and eliminate #r10 #o9300411#s#k.

no.0: Don't give up. You were once a warrior with legendary prowess.

1.0: You finished those #o9300411#s? Amazing. You're fast, you're strong, and you're hardy. You'll make a great Warrior. Or, dare I say it... a Legendary Warrior? Ha!\r\n#L0##b(Such praise for this meager training... how embarrassing...)#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, don't look so gloomy. All this is just a part of the process... you'll get your strength back in no time.

yes.0: All right, time to put it all together. Finish this last course, and you'll be done with your Resistance training. Let me know when you're ready.

mob.0: Your condition may be poor after pushing yourself too much. Please try again, calm and steady.
